_note: WAISentry Security Posture & Application Review for the fictional client Kitewing Software (kitewing.example), plus the 48-hour onboarding template and the cost comparison from the WAISentry brief. Synthetic.

review.name: Security Posture & Application Review
review.method: Read-only checks through native Google Workspace APIs; nothing installed on laptops

baseline.value: 55 of 62 people enforced; 49 on security keys

current.value: 62 of 62 enforced; 60 on security keys; 2 contractors on Google prompts until 2026-11-09

checks.why: Phishing-resistant keys stopped the stolen-password sign-ins in INC-1101-01 and INC-1028-01; prompt users remain exposed to MFA fatigue (INC-1021-01).
checks.fix: Finish security keys for the 2 contractors; then enforce keys only

baseline.value: 6 super admins, including the CEO and a former IT provider account

current.value: 3 (Noah Kim, Hugo Laurent, break-glass); former provider account deleted 2026-10-09

checks.why: Every super admin is a full-tenant takeover if phished.
checks.fix: Keep 2-3 named admins plus one break-glass account

baseline.value: Anyone-with-the-link allowed everywhere; the Marketing OU defaults new files to 'anyone with the link'

checks.why: This default produced INC-1106-01 this morning (Confidential customer export made public).
checks.fix: Default to 'restricted'; allow external sharing with expiry; block public links on Confidential labels

current.value: Disabled since 2026-11-02; billflow.example allowlisted for the AP mailbox

checks.why: Hidden external forwarding is the core of business email compromise — it was used in INC-1101-01.

baseline.value: IMAP on for everyone (4 active IMAP clients); scan-to-email uses an app password

current.value: IMAP limited to the AP shared mailbox; the Millbrook scanner still uses an app password

checks.fix: Move the scanner to an SMTP relay restricted to the office IP

baseline.value: Any user could grant any scope to any app; 3 unverified apps held by 9 users

current.value: New unverified grants blocked since 2026-11-03 (14-app allowlist); 4 legacy unverified grants remain for 10 users

checks.why: Consent phishing needs no password and bypasses MFA — the entry point of INC-1101-01.
checks.fix: Revoke QuickSign Free, Docs PDF Converter Plus, AI Meeting Notes Free and Calendar Sync Pro

baseline.value: Former IT-provider super admin still active; 3 ex-employee accounts suspended but not cleaned up

current.value: Provider account deleted; 3 suspended ex-employee accounts awaiting data transfer (no sign-in possible)

checks.why: Orphaned admin accounts are a common way back in.
checks.fix: Finish the data transfer and delete
Move to p=reject after 30 clean days

baseline.value: Audit logs only in the admin console; nobody reviews them out of hours

current.value: Streamed to the in-tenant WAISentry pipeline since 2026-10-05; reviewed 24/7

checks.why: Without it, a 2:00 AM alert waits until Monday morning.

baseline.value: EDR on 54 of 58 EDR-capable endpoints; a Windows 10 reception PC; a Windows Server 2016 file server

current.value: EDR healthy on 56 of 58 (gaps: contractor BYOD laptop; MB-WS07 removed 2026-10-31); MB-FS01 support ends 2027-01-12

checks.why: The unmanaged reception PC launched the 2026-10-30 password spray (INC-1030-01).
checks.fix: EDR on the BYOD laptop or remove its access; plan the MB-FS01 migration to Drive

baseline.value: Basic management for phones; company data wiped on removal

checks.why: Lost phones cannot keep company mail.

days.name: Connect the tenant via native APIs
tasks: Deploy the WAISentry telemetry pipeline into the client's own Google Cloud project (API log evaluation and correlation stay in-tenant)
Authorise read-only Workspace connectors: Admin SDK Reports API (login, token, Drive, Gmail and admin audit), Directory API and Alert Center
Create the tenant tokenisation key — it never leaves the client's tenant
Connect SaaS security tools by API (for Kitewing: KnowBe4, Mimecast, DNSFilter, web proxy, EDR)
client_inputs: A super admin for about one hour
List of SaaS security tools and API access

days.name: Baseline calibration + hybrid setup
tasks: Back-fill the audit history available in the Workspace reports and calibrate baselines: known devices, travel, VIP and finance roles, sanctioned apps, allowlisted forwarding
Hybrid: point the firewall/IDS and the domain controller / file server events at a syslog forwarder that ships to the in-tenant pipeline
Send test events end to end from every source
client_inputs: A small VM or appliance for the syslog forwarder

days.name: Continuous active defence
tasks: Sign the pre-approved containment playbooks (PB-01 to PB-04) and the escalation matrix
Tabletop one simulated incident end to end (consent phishing)
24/7 monitoring live; first daily summary; monthly SOC report cadence starts
